# Neovate Formatter

<!-- Auto-generated by `pnpm docs:formatters`. Do not edit manually. -->

PromptScript compiles your `.prs` sources to native Neovate configuration. The main output is `.neovate/rules/project.md`. It is not enabled by default, add it to `targets` to use it.

## Enable the Target

```yaml
targets:
  - neovate
```

Pick an output version when you need more than the default:

```yaml
targets:
  - neovate:
      version: full
```

## At a Glance

| Property          | Value                       |
| ----------------- | --------------------------- |
| **Tier**          | Tier 3                      |
| **Main output**   | `.neovate/rules/project.md` |
| **Dot directory** | `.neovate/`                 |
| **Skills**        | No                          |
| **Agents**        | No                          |
| **Commands**      | No                          |
| **Local files**   | No                          |

## Output Files

| File              | Path                        | Purpose           |
| ----------------- | --------------------------- | ----------------- |
| Main instructions | `.neovate/rules/project.md` | Primary rule file |

## Output Versions

| Version          | Output                                |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `simple`         | Single .neovate/rules/project.md file |
| `multifile`      | Single .neovate/rules/project.md file |
| `full` (default) | Single .neovate/rules/project.md file |

## MCP and Hooks

| Block         | Support       |
| ------------- | ------------- |
| `@mcpServers` | Not supported |
| `@hooks`      | Not supported |

Native hook reference: <https://promptscript.dev/docs/guides/hooks/>
